concepts.way: misconception: Calling StdIn.readInt() twice returns the same value twice.
concepts.quote: while (StdIn.readInt() != 0) System.out.println(StdIn.readInt()); It prints each number.
concepts.why: Each readInt() takes a new token, so the condition and the body read different numbers. The loop skips every other number and only prints 5, but the student says it prints each number.
println is used correctly to print a value, but the answer gives no reasoning about how it outputs a line or how that applies to these values.
The while syntax with a condition tested before a one-statement body is correct, but there is no trace and no correct reasoning about the passes.
The answer says nothing about the graph input format.
